The '''Chrona system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], it contained the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]], [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]].
